notes.title: Adios is a small, quiet, 90-minute narrative with a knack for storytelling texture
notes.notes:
I keep finding myself describing games in terms of "texture" at the moment, and I keep worrying that nobody knows what that means - I'm not sure I know what it means, so I wouldn't blame them. But I know it's there, and I know a game's texture matters, but how to spell it out?

Maybe the best explanation is by example, which in this case is Adios. Adios is not a long game, and being of limited scope and budget it's not particularly grand, either. You'll probably finish it in one sitting, clocking in at less than two hours, and what you'll do in those two hours is simple: you walk, and talk, and just live a day in another life.

This is the magic of it though. Adios is just a story. There are little activities along the way - throwing horseshoes, catching fish, shooting clay pigeons - but little more, and they're of little consequence, success or failure of little relevance to why those activities are really there. There are no puzzles or action, or even mysteries to untangle, and so the joy of it has to come from elsewhere: from the rare source of relinquished control - agency that's sacrificed, as opposed to worshipped, allowing you to simply suspend belief and float.

notes.title: ADIOS Amigos 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
The response from our players have been overwhelming, thank you!
We read everything and are very grateful for your help in improving ADIOS Amigos.
Here is the first round of updates and improvements!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33500729/0bbc6bd10f48af83fd4a2e49a5737c92dfc0b6e0.png[/img]
[h1]Release notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]In-game menu with help and quit options
[*]Improved support for non 16:9 monitors
[*]Some users have experienced controller issues caused by worn (loose) thumb-sticks. this should no longer be a problem.
[*]Improved stability
[*]Added support for error reporting
[*]Fixed leaderboard browsing
[*]Disabled the possibility of becoming passenger while playing single player.
[*]Tweaked the "Sweet-tooth", "Take me to your Leader" and "Amazing Discoverer" achievements
[*]Button-prompts for "Revive" now working properly
[*]Fixed broken pop-up icons for powerups in co-op
[*]Improved memory management
[*]Fixed faulty button prompts for controllable rocket-engines on space-stations
[*]Fixed crew-display sometimes showing incorrect images for docked space-shuttles
[*]Fixed issue where you couldn't join with additional players after playing a round
[*]Fixed graphical glitches for jetpack effects and carried astronauts
[/list]
